review: machine-written (Claude): the child's lines in it, their translations in sl, en and de; not reviewed by a native speaker
about: What the child says in «Vedo, vedo» (companion/SCENES.md, "I spy"): {word} is the thing's word as the scene says it, with its article (in a translation: what it means), {letter} the word's first letter. Warm and cold are Italian children's fuochino and acqua.

offer.de: Spielen wir «Ich sehe was, was du nicht siehst»?

start.it: Vedo, vedo una cosa che tu non vedi …
start.sl: Vidim, vidim nekaj, česar ti ne vidiš …
start.en: I spy with my little eye something …
start.de: Ich sehe was, was du nicht siehst …

again.it: Ancora! Vedo, vedo una cosa che tu non vedi …
again.sl: Še enkrat! Vidim, vidim nekaj, česar ti ne vidiš …
again.en: Again! I spy with my little eye something …
again.de: Noch mal! Ich sehe was, was du nicht siehst …

sg.en: It's the {word}! Look, here it is.

end.it: Grazie, è stato bello! Domani di nuovo?
end.sl: Hvala, lepo je bilo! Jutri spet?
end.en: Thanks, that was fun! Again tomorrow?
end.de: Danke, das war schön! Morgen wieder?

end_all.it: Hai trovato tutto! Grazie, è stato bello.
end_all.sl: Vse si {m:našel|f:našla}! Hvala, lepo je bilo.
end_all.en: You found them all! Thanks, that was fun.
end_all.de: Du hast alles gefunden! Danke, das war schön.

letter.de: Es fängt mit dem Buchstaben {letter} an.

memory.de: unser Spiel «Ich sehe was, was du nicht siehst»
